lines.say: Zoho to Claude? Five routes, not one.
lines.show: Zoho to Claude? Five routes, not one.

lines.say: Two routes bring Zoho data into Claude. Three put Claude to work inside Zoho.
lines.show: Two routes bring Zoho data into Claude. Three put Claude to work inside Zoho.

lines.say: Number one, Zoho's own connectors in Claude's directory. Fast, but some tools delete records.
lines.show: No. 1: Zoho's own connectors in Claude's directory. Fast, but some tools delete records.

lines.say: Number two, your own Zoho MCP server. Only the tools you choose.
lines.show: No. 2: your own Zoho MCP server. Only the tools you choose.

lines.say: Number three, an Anthropic key in Zeeya Agents or Zoho Creator.
lines.show: No. 3: an Anthropic key in Zia Agents or Zoho Creator.

lines.say: Number four, Zoho Flow. A new lead sends text to Claude, with no code.
lines.show: No. 4: Zoho Flow. A new lead sends text to Claude, with no code.

lines.say: Number five, a Deluge function that calls the Claude API. Full control.
lines.show: No. 5: a Deluge function that calls the Claude API. Full control.

lines.say: Whichever you choose, start read only. Keep every change behind an approval.
lines.show: Whichever you choose, start read-only. Keep every change behind an approval.
